prompts.mon: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated sprite atlas for Crown & Kingdoms, original medieval isometric RTS. Input image is reference for character identity and painted style. Create a 1536x1024 PNG with GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 equally sized384x256 cells. No text, labels, grid lines, background, scenery, floor, ground plane, shadows or glow. Each complete character and attached equipment comfortably contained inside its own cell with at least20pixels transparent padding on all sides. NO character parts crossing cell boundaries. Same feet baseline, size, proportions, lighting and fixed camera in ALL16cells. Elevated isometric view about30degrees, each figure faces screen RIGHT with slight front view. Crisp small hand-painted medieval game miniatures with earthy material textures and dark readable contours. Clear cobalt BLUE cloth for later team recolouring; neutral steel, wood, leather and skin. Each frame has genuinely different articulated body and limb poses. Exactly one character in each cell, no detached equipment fragments or floating projectiles, no eight-direction turntable. Subject: hooded bearded medieval monk inspired by reference: brown wool robe, rope belt, leather sandals, simple wooden cross-topped walking staff in LEFT hand. Add a distinct cobalt blue fabric stole and blue hood edging so team is clear; keep the robe earthy brown. Calm face, lean adult proportions. Upper TWO rows frames0-7: eight-frame walking cycle to the right, alternating feet and passing positions, robe folds change with knees, right arm natural walking motion, staff advances then plants, sandals visible. Lower TWO rows frames8-15: eight-frame continuous conversion/prayer casting gesture loop, NOT melee:8resting ready, right hand at chest;9lift right hand;10open palm forward;11extend right forearm;12full blessing gesture towards right;13hold blessing with altered hand/robe;14draw hand back;15hand at chest ready. Staff remains planted and connected to left hand in every casting cell, same height as walk. Subtle torso motion, NO attacking with staff, NO weapons other than staff, NO magic balls/rays/glows/particles, NO kneeling, NO second monk.
